description_en: Queries the performance data of a MongoDB instance
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-db-instance-performance --db-instance-id dds-bp26350000 --key CpuUsage --start-time 2022-06-13T10:58Z --end-time 2022-06-13T11:58Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstancePerformance

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

NodeId is required when specifying a sharded cluster instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a mongos or shard node in the sharded cluster instance. This parameter lets you query the performance of a single node.

Available only when DBInstanceId is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID，可用于查询单个节点的性能情况。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The performance metrics. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/216973.html.

To specify multiple metrics, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
性能指标，取值详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/216973.html。

如需传入多个指标请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The role ID of a node in a standalone or replica set instance. To query the role ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62134.html operation.

Available only when DBInstanceId is set to the ID of a standalone or replica set instance
parameters.help_zh:
单节点实例或副本集实例的节点角色ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62134.html接口查询。
当DBInstanceId参数传入的是单节点实例ID或副本集实例ID时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en: The data granularity of the performance metrics in seconds. Valid values: 5, 30, 60, 600, 1800, 3600, and 86400
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The role of a node in a standalone or replica set instance. Valid values:

Primary: The primary node.

Secondary: A secondary node.

Available only when DBInstanceId is set to the ID of a standalone or replica set instance.

If DBInstanceId is set to the ID of a standalone instance, this parameter only supports the value Primary
parameters.help_zh:
单节点实例或副本集实例的节点角色，取值说明：
Primary：主节点。
Secondary：从节点。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是单节点实例ID或副本集实例ID时，本参数才可用。
当DBInstanceId参数传入的是单节点实例时，本参数的取值仅支持Primary
parameters.name: replica_set_role

parameters.help_en:
The Search node ID.

Available only after the Search feature is enabled for the instance
parameters.help_zh:
Search节点ID。
当实例开通Search功能后，本参数才可用
parameters.name: search_id

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
